description: Conformance corpus for domain logic implemented independently in the React Native app and in nouri-api. Inputs and expected outputs only: no framework types, no HTTP, no database. Both repositories run these cases against their own implementation, so the two cannot drift apart while both test suites stay green.
notes: Expected values encode the CURRENT agreed product contract, not an independent proof of correctness. A case exists to stop the two sides diverging; changing one deliberately means changing the fixture, which makes the change visible in review.
Rounding follows JavaScript Math.round: halves go toward positive infinity, so 2.5 -> 3 and -2.5 -> -2. Cases below pin that explicitly.
Time-of-day cases are fixed to UTC so both runtimes can evaluate them without a timezone argument the mobile helper does not take.

roundNutrient.name: negative half also rounds toward positive infinity
very small value collapses to zero at one place
very small value survives at two places

getFoodResolvedServing.name: per-100g with no explicit serving falls back to 100 g
a decimal serving size is kept
zero serving size is not a serving size
blank unit falls back to the basis unit
an unknown basis degrades to per-100g

scaleFoodNutritionForQuantity.name: per-100g at 100 g is the stored value
per-100g at 33 g produces fractional macros
custom serving size scales against that serving
missing macros are treated as zero
a tiny quantity rounds calories to zero but keeps a macro decimal

calculateLoggedNutrition.name: a food entry scales by quantity over serving
a quick add is never scaled

getLoggedCaloriesRaw.name: returns the UNROUNDED value, so aggregates do not accumulate error
quick add returns its stored calories unscaled

sumLoggedNutrition.name: sums unrounded then rounds once — three 0.4 kcal entries total 1, not 0

calculateQuickAddCaloriesFromMacros.name: fractional macros round to a whole calorie
a fractional total lands on the rounding half

clampCalorieTarget.name: a decimal on the half rounds up
rounding happens before the ceiling check

getEffectiveCalorieTargetForDate.name: no overrides falls back to the base target
an empty override list falls back
an all-null override list falls back
a zero override is not an override
no base and no override yields nothing
an override applies even with no base

getMealSlotFromLabel.name: a label containing the slot name matches
an unrelated label is not a slot

buildDuplicateKey.name: a food entry keys on source, food, time, quantity and meal
a different second is a different entry
a missing time is explicit, not empty
createdAt is the fallback when loggedAt is absent
a null quantity is an empty field
meal type is trimmed but not lowercased
a quick add includes its name and full macro payload
two quick adds differing only in manual-energy flag are distinct

decodeFoodId.name: a plain catalogue id is a food item
a negative id below the meal offset is a recipe
the largest recipe id is one below the offset
a negative id at the meal offset is meal 0
a negative id above the offset is a custom meal
a POSITIVE id at the meal offset is still a catalogue food
a POSITIVE id far above the meal offset is still a catalogue food
zero is a food item, not a meal
a non-integer id is never synthetic

computeRecipeNutrition.name: a single 100g-basis ingredient at its basis weight
double the amount doubles the nutrition
a prepared weight changes grams per serving, not the macros
a serving-basis ingredient scales by its stored serving size
no ingredients yields null nutrition, not zero
zero-amount ingredients contribute nothing and do not count as ingredients
zero servings is treated as one rather than dividing by zero
a zero prepared weight is ignored in favour of the ingredient total
calories round to whole numbers, macros to one decimal
a food with null macros contributes weight only
calories round to whole numbers even when the split is fractional
a macro that needs more than one decimal is rounded to one

resolveGoalStrategy.name: a matching goal and strategy is kept
a strategy from the wrong goal falls back to that goal's default
a missing strategy falls back to the goal's default
an unknown goal keeps a recognisable strategy
an unknown goal and an unknown strategy resolve to nothing
an unknown goal with an unknown strategy is null

getGoalCalorieOffset.name: a mismatched strategy uses the goal's default offset

estimateAdaptiveTdee.name: no weight change means maintenance equals intake
losing weight puts maintenance above intake
gaining weight puts maintenance below intake
a zero span has no answer
a negative span has no answer

getAdaptiveRecommendationConfidence.name: high needs 24 days, 8 weigh-ins and a 21-day span
one day short of high is medium
one weigh-in short of high is medium
one span-day short of high is medium
one short of medium is low
one complete day short of low is nothing
one weigh-in short of low is nothing
one span-day short of low is nothing

applyAdaptiveRecommendationToTargets.name: no current target adopts the recommendation outright
a small move is applied in full
an upward move is capped at 150
a downward move is capped at -150
per-day overrides move with the base, keeping their offsets
overrides are clamped to the allowed range
with no current target the overrides do not move

buildAdaptiveRecommendation.name: one short of the 14 complete-day minimum
enough days, one short of the 5 weigh-in minimum
enough days and weigh-ins, one short of the 14-day span
exactly at every minimum: low confidence
high confidence needs 24 days, 8 weigh-ins and a 21-day span
losing weight raises the target, capped at +150
gaining weight lowers the target, capped at -150
no current target adopts the recommendation outright
a target already close to the trend is left unchanged
a bulking goal with a cutting strategy uses the bulking default
complete days with nothing logged count as genuine zeros
an unset goal applies no offset

getEntryScaleFactor.name: a food entry scales by quantity over serving size
a whole serving is a factor of one
a quick add is always one, whatever the numbers say
a zero serving size degrades to one rather than dividing by zero
a negative serving size degrades to one

encodeFoodId.name: a recipe encodes to its negated id
a meal encodes below the offset
meal 0 lands exactly on the offset
an already-negative recipe id is not double-negated
an already-negative meal id is not double-negated

formatGoalStrategyMeta.name: a deficit shows its daily offset
a surplus shows a signed offset
a mismatched strategy is described as the goal's default

getDailyCalorieOverrideForDate.name: a null entry means no override
a short array does not throw
